name: Jacob
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Eliud begat Eleazar, Eleazar begat Matthan, Matthan begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary. Matthew follows Joseph, whose father is Jacob.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

points: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel; and on down to Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ. That is the Branch line, right through Zerubbabel. Everybody see that.
